# HUU saliva
```{r}
# =====================================================
# 1. SUBSET HUU
# =====================================================

physeq_HUU <- subset_samples(
  physeq_all_389,
  study_group == "HUU"
)

physeq_HUU <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HUU) > 0,
  physeq_HUU
)

# =====================================================
# PREVALENCE FILTER
# taxa present in >=10% samples
# =====================================================

prev_threshold <- 0.1 * nsamples(physeq_HUU)

physeq_HUU <- filter_taxa(
  physeq_HUU,
  function(x) sum(x > 0) >= prev_threshold,
  prune = TRUE
)

physeq_HUU <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HUU) > 5,
  physeq_HUU
)

physeq_HUU

# =====================================================
# 2. EXTRACT METADATA
# =====================================================

meta_HUU <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HUU))

meta_HUU <- meta_HUU %>%
  mutate(
    host_age = as.numeric(host_age),
    host_sex = as.factor(host_sex),
    caries_IL = as.factor(caries_IL),
    logCD4 = log10(CD4.Count.1)
  )

meta_HUU$logCD4_c <- scale(
  meta_HUU$logCD4,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = FALSE
)

# =====================================================
# 3. MATCH CYTOKINE MATRIX
# =====================================================

cytok_LLOD30 <- masaliva_LODimputed389_filt  # substitute maplasma_LODimputed389_filt when using plasma 

colnames(cytok_LLOD30)

cyto_HUU <- cytok_LLOD30[
  rownames(meta_HUU),
]

# =====================================================
# 4. LOG TRANSFORM
# =====================================================

cyto_HUU_log <- log10(cyto_HUU + 1e-5)

# =====================================================
# 5. Adjust CYTOKINES
# for age + sex
# =====================================================

cyto_resid_HUU <- apply(
  cyto_HUU_log,
  2,
  function(y) {
    fit <- lm(
      y ~ host_age + host_sex,
      data = meta_HUU
    )
    residuals(fit)
  }
)

cyto_resid_HUU <- as.data.frame(cyto_resid_HUU)
rownames(cyto_resid_HUU) <- rownames(meta_HUU)

```




# mclust HUU Saliva / plasma

```{r}
# Choose cytokine matrix
cytok_mat <- cyto_resid_HUU

# Keep shared samples only
shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(cytok_mat), rownames(meta_HUU))

cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta_sub_HUU <- meta_HUU[shared_ids, ]

# -----------------------------
# Remove non-numeric columns
# -----------------------------
cytok_mat <- cytok_mat %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

# -----------------------------
# Remove near-zero variance variables
# -----------------------------
vars <- apply(cytok_mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[, vars > 0, drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------------
# Scale data
# -----------------------------
X <- scale(cytok_mat)

# =========================================================
# PCA
# =========================================================

pca_res <- prcomp(
  X,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# Scree plot
fviz_eig(
  pca_res,
  addlabels = TRUE,
  ylim = c(0, 60)
) +
  ggtitle("HUU Cytokines: Scree Plot")

# Variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)

variance_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(var_explained)),
  Variance = var_explained,
  Cumulative = cumsum(var_explained)
)

print(variance_df)

# =========================================================
# Choose PCs for clustering
# =========================================================

n_pcs <- which(cumsum(var_explained) >= 0.80)[1]

cat("Using", n_pcs, "PCs for Mclust\n")

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$x[, 1:n_pcs]
)

# =========================================================
# Mclust
# =========================================================

mc <- Mclust(pca_scores)

summary(mc)

# Cluster assignments
clusters <- factor(mc$classification)

# Add to metadata
meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster <- clusters

table(meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster)
```



# mclust associations

```{r}
# ================================
# Continuous variables
# ================================

# Age
age_test <- kruskal_test(
  meta_sub_HUU,
  host_age ~ Mclust_cluster
)

# ================================
# Categorical variables
# ================================

# Sex
sex_table <- table(
  meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster,
  meta_sub_HUU$host_sex
)

sex_test <- fisher.test(sex_table)


# Caries
caries_table <- table(
  meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster,
  meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL
)

caries_test <- fisher.test(caries_table)

# ================================
# Display results
# ================================

age_test
sex_test
caries_test


# =========================================================
# Fit linear regression
# =========================================================

fit_cd4_adj <- lm(
  logCD4 ~ Mclust_cluster + host_age + host_sex + caries_IL,
  data = meta_sub_HUU
)

summary(fit_cd4_adj)

# Estimated differences with 95% CI
cd4_effects <- cbind(
  Estimate = coef(fit_cd4_adj),
  confint(fit_cd4_adj)
)

cd4_effects


# =========================================================
# Optional: relevel cluster (Cluster 3 as reference)
# =========================================================
meta_sub_HUU_ <- meta_sub_HUU

meta_sub_HUU_$Mclust_cluster <- factor(
  meta_sub_HUU_$Mclust_cluster,
  levels = c("3", "1", "2")
)

# =========================================================
# Logistic regression:
# caries ~ cluster + age + sex
# =========================================================

fit_caries_adj <- glm(
  caries_IL ~ Mclust_cluster + host_age + host_sex + logCD4_c,
  data = meta_sub_HUU_,
  family = binomial
)

summary(fit_caries_adj)

# Odds ratios with 95% CI
exp(cbind(
  OR = coef(fit_caries_adj),
  confint(fit_caries_adj)
))



# =========================================================
# Logistic regression:
# Sex ~ immune phenotype + covariates
# =========================================================


meta_sub_HUU_$host_sex <- factor(
  meta_sub_HUU_$host_sex,
  levels = c("F", "M")        # Female reference; estimates odds of male
)

fit_sex_adj <- glm(
  host_sex ~ Mclust_cluster + host_age + caries_IL,
  data = meta_sub_HUU_,
  family = binomial
)

summary(fit_sex_adj)

# Odds ratios with 95% CI
sex_OR <- exp(cbind(
  OR = coef(fit_sex_adj),
  confint(fit_sex_adj)
))

sex_OR

```

# Biplot HUU saliva

```{r}

#----------------------------------------------------------
# BIPLOT
#----------------------------------------------------------

# =========================================================
# PCA dataframe
# =========================================================

pca_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(pca_res$x),
  PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
  PC3 = pca_res$x[, 3],
  meta_sub_HUU
)

# -----------------------------
# PCA scores (samples)
# -----------------------------
scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
scores$Cluster <- pca_df$Mclust_cluster

# -----------------------------
# PCA loadings (variables)
# -----------------------------
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation)

# scale arrows for visualization (important)
arrow_scale <- 3  # adjust if arrows too long/short

loadings$Cytokine <- rownames(loadings)

# variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)
pc1_var <- round(100 * var_explained[1], 1)
pc2_var <- round(100 * var_explained[2], 1)



cluster_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#D73027",
  "2" = "#2C7BB6",
  "3" = "#1B9E77"
)


p_HUU_saliva_biplot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = scores,
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  stat_ellipse(
    data = scores,
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      xend = PC1 * arrow_scale,
      yend = PC2 * arrow_scale
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = PC1 * arrow_scale,
      y = PC2 * arrow_scale,
      label = Cytokine
    ),
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cluster_colors,
    labels = c(
      "1" = "S1",
      "2" = "S2",
      "3" = "S3"
    ),
    name = "HUU Phenotype"
  ) +
  labs(
    #title = "PCA Biplot of saliva Cytokines Clusters in HUU",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "% variance)"),
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

p_HUU_saliva_biplot


```





# Box plot HUU saliva

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Prepare plotting dataframe
# =========================================================

plot_df <- cytok_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = clusters,
    Sample = rownames(cytok_mat)
  )


# =========================================================
# Convert to long format
# =========================================================

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Cluster, Sample),
    names_to = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

plot_long$Cluster <- factor(plot_long$Cluster)

table(plot_long$Cluster)


# =========================================================
# Create phenotype labels
# 1 = S1, 2 = S2, 3 = S3
# =========================================================

plot_long$Phenotype <- factor(
  plot_long$Cluster,
  levels = c("1", "2", "3"),
  labels = c("S1", "S2", "S3")
)

table(plot_long$Phenotype)


# =========================================================
# GLOBAL TEST
# Kruskal-Wallis for 3 phenotypes
# =========================================================

kw_df <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  kruskal_test(Value ~ Phenotype) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj.signif = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# Y POSITION FOR GLOBAL STARS
# =========================================================

y_pos <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  summarise(
    y.position = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10
  )

kw_df <- kw_df %>%
  left_join(y_pos, by = "Cytokine")


# =========================================================
# Order cytokines
# =========================================================

plot_long_order <- plot_long %>%
  mutate(
    Cytokine = factor(
      Cytokine,
      levels = c(
        "Saliva_IL1_alpha",
        "Saliva_IL8",
        #"Saliva_MCP1",

        "Saliva_IFN_gamma",
        "Saliva_IL4",
        "Saliva_IL5",
        "Saliva_IL6"
      )
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)
# =========================================================

pairwise_df <- plot_long_order %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Value ~ Phenotype,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Phenotype")


# =========================================================
# Phenotype colors
# =========================================================

phenotype_colors <- c(
  "S1" = "#D73027",
  "S2" = "#2C7BB6",
  "S3" = "#1B9E77"
)


# =========================================================
# Plot each cytokine
# =========================================================

cytokine_order <- levels(plot_long_order$Cytokine)

p_list <- lapply(cytokine_order, function(cyt) {

  subdf <- plot_long_order %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)

  pair_sub <- pairwise_df %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)

  ggplot(
    subdf,
    aes(
      x = Phenotype,
      y = Value,
      fill = Phenotype
    )
  ) +

    # Boxplots
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.85,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +

    # Individual samples
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Phenotype),
      width = 0.12,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +

    # Pairwise significance
    stat_pvalue_manual(
      pair_sub,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 4
    ) +

    # Colors
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = phenotype_colors
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = phenotype_colors
    ) +

    # Theme
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

    labs(
      title = gsub("Saliva_", "", cyt),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 12,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
})


# =========================================================
# Combine plots
# =========================================================

final_plot_saliva_HUU <- wrap_plots(
  p_list,
  ncol = 3
) +
  plot_annotation(
    # title = "Saliva Cytokine Levels Across Phenotypes in HUU"
  )


# Display
final_plot_saliva_HUU

# box plot global axes
box_HUU <- ggdraw(final_plot_saliva_HUU) +
  draw_label("HUU Phenotype", x = 0.5, y = 0.005, vjust = 0) +
  draw_label("Log10 cytokine level (age- and sex-adjusted)", x = 0.0, y = 0.5, angle = 90, vjust = 1)

box_HUU

```



# Significance and effect sizes HUU saliva

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)
# =========================================================

pairwise_df <- plot_long_order %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Value ~ Cluster,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# =========================================================
# Rank-biserial effect sizes for each pairwise comparison
# =========================================================

eff12 <- plot_long_order %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% c("1", "2")) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "1",
    group2 = "2"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

eff13 <- plot_long_order %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% c("1", "3")) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "1",
    group2 = "3"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

eff23 <- plot_long_order %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% c("2", "3")) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "2",
    group2 = "3"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

effect_df <- bind_rows(
  eff12,
  eff13,
  eff23
) %>%
  select(
    Cytokine,
    group1,
    group2,
    effsize,
    magnitude
  )

# =========================================================
# Merge Wilcoxon results with effect sizes
# =========================================================

wilcox_effect_table <- pairwise_df %>%
  left_join(
    effect_df,
    by = c("Cytokine", "group1", "group2")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = round(statistic, 1),
    p = signif(p, 3),
    p.adj = signif(p.adj, 3),
    effsize = round(effsize, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Cytokine,
    group1,
    group2,
    n1,
    n2,
    statistic,
    p,
    p.adj,
    p.adj.signif,
    effsize,
    magnitude
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Cytokine,
    group1,
    group2
  )

# =========================================================
# Display
# =========================================================

print(wilcox_effect_table)

# Optional data frame for export
wilcox_effect_table_df <- as.data.frame(wilcox_effect_table)

wilcox_effect_table_df

```


#Beta diversity  HUU saliva

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Create phyloseq object with HUU cluster assignments
# =========================================================

if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_HUU)) {
  physeq_HUU <- t(physeq_HUU)
}

physeq_HUU

physeq_HUU_clust <- physeq_HUU

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster)
meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL)
meta_sub_HUU$host_sex <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$host_sex)
rownames(meta_sub_HUU) <- meta_sub_HUU$host_subject_id

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure sample order matches
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_data(physeq_HUU_clust) <- sample_data(meta_sub_HUU)

physeq_HUU_clust

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extract OTU table (counts)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- as(otu_table(physeq_HUU_clust), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(physeq_HUU_clust)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

otu <- as.data.frame(otu)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HUU_clust))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Bray-Curtis distance
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- otu / rowSums(otu)

bray <- vegdist(
  otu,
  method = "bray"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PCoA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pcoa <- cmdscale(
  bray,
  eig = TRUE,
  k = 2
)

var_exp <- pcoa$eig / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0])

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcoa$points[, 1],
  PC2 = pcoa$points[, 2],
  meta
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Overall PERMANOVA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)

perm_cluster <- adonis2(
  bray ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c,
  data = meta,
  by = "margin"
)

perm_cluster

# =========================================================
# Pairwise PERMANOVA
# =========================================================

# -------------------------
# 1 vs 2
# -------------------------
phy_12 <- subset_samples(
  physeq_HUU_clust,
  Mclust_cluster %in% c("1", "2")
)

phy_12 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_12) > 0,
  phy_12
)

bray_12 <- phyloseq::distance(
  phy_12,
  method = "bray"
)

meta_12 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_12))

set.seed(123)

adonis_12 <- adonis2(
  bray_12 ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c,
  data = meta_12,
  by = "margin"
)

# -------------------------
# 1 vs 3
# -------------------------
phy_13 <- subset_samples(
  physeq_HUU_clust,
  Mclust_cluster %in% c("1", "3")
)

phy_13 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_13) > 0,
  phy_13
)

bray_13 <- phyloseq::distance(
  phy_13,
  method = "bray"
)

meta_13 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_13))

set.seed(123)

adonis_13 <- adonis2(
  bray_13 ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c,
  data = meta_13,
  by = "margin"
)

# -------------------------
# 2 vs 3
# -------------------------
phy_23 <- subset_samples(
  physeq_HUU_clust,
  Mclust_cluster %in% c("2", "3")
)

phy_23 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_23) > 0,
  phy_23
)

bray_23 <- phyloseq::distance(
  phy_23,
  method = "bray"
)

meta_23 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_23))

set.seed(123)

adonis_23 <- adonis2(
  bray_23 ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c,
  data = meta_23,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_12
adonis_13
adonis_23
```

#ANCOMBC HUU saliva

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Prepare phyloseq object for ANCOM-BC2 (HUU)
# =========================================================

# Make sure taxa are rows
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_HUU)) {
  physeq_HUU <- t(physeq_HUU)
}

physeq_HUU_ancom <- physeq_HUU

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster)
meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL)
meta_sub_HUU$host_sex <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$host_sex)

table(meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure sample order matches
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_data(physeq_HUU_ancom) <- sample_data(meta_sub_HUU)

physeq_HUU_ancom

## Here use only large clusters
physeq_HUU_ancom_23 <- subset_samples(physeq_HUU_ancom, Mclust_cluster %in% c(2, 3))
physeq_HUU_ancom_23

# Check the levels
levels(sample_data(physeq_HUU_ancom_23)$Mclust_cluster)

# =========================================================
# Run ANCOM-BC2
# =========================================================

library(ANCOMBC)
set.seed(123)

ancom_res_HUU <- ancombc2(
  data = physeq_HUU_ancom_23,

  # Fixed effects
  fix_formula = "Mclust_cluster + caries_IL + host_age + host_sex + logCD4_c",

  # No random effects
  rand_formula = NULL,

  tax_level = "Species",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,
  s0_perc = 0.05,

  group = "Mclust_cluster",
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,

  iter_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100,
    verbose = TRUE
  ),

  em_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100
  ),

  lme_control = lme4::lmerControl(),

  mdfdr_control = list(
    fwer_ctrl_method = "BH",
    B = 1
  ),

  global = TRUE,
  pairwise = TRUE,
  # dunnet = TRUE,
  trend = FALSE,
```

#PLASMA

# HUU plasma
```{r}
# =====================================================
# 1. SUBSET HUU
# =====================================================

physeq_HUU <- subset_samples(
  physeq_all_389,
  study_group == "HUU"
)

physeq_HUU <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HUU) > 0,
  physeq_HUU
)

# =====================================================
# PREVALENCE FILTER
# taxa present in >=10% samples
# =====================================================

prev_threshold <- 0.1 * nsamples(physeq_HUU)

physeq_HUU <- filter_taxa(
  physeq_HUU,
  function(x) sum(x > 0) >= prev_threshold,
  prune = TRUE
)

physeq_HUU <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HUU) > 5,
  physeq_HUU
)

physeq_HUU

# =====================================================
# 2. EXTRACT METADATA
# =====================================================

meta_HUU <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HUU))

meta_HUU <- meta_HUU %>%
  mutate(
    host_age = as.numeric(host_age),
    host_sex = as.factor(host_sex),
    caries_IL = as.factor(caries_IL),
    logCD4 = log10(CD4.Count.1)
  )

meta_HUU$logCD4_c <- scale(
  meta_HUU$logCD4,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = FALSE
)

# =====================================================
# 3. MATCH CYTOKINE MATRIX
# =====================================================

cytok_LLOD30 <- maplasma_LODimputed389_filt  # substitute maplasma_LODimputed389_filt when using plasma 

colnames(cytok_LLOD30)

cyto_HUU <- cytok_LLOD30[
  rownames(meta_HUU),
]

# =====================================================
# 4. LOG TRANSFORM
# =====================================================

cyto_HUU_log <- log10(cyto_HUU + 1e-5)

# =====================================================
# 5. RESIDUALIZE CYTOKINES
# regress out age + sex
# =====================================================

cyto_resid_HUU <- apply(
  cyto_HUU_log,
  2,
  function(y) {
    fit <- lm(
      y ~ host_age + host_sex,
      data = meta_HUU
    )
    residuals(fit)
  }
)

cyto_resid_HUU <- as.data.frame(cyto_resid_HUU)
rownames(cyto_resid_HUU) <- rownames(meta_HUU)

```

# mclust HUU Saliva / plasma

```{r}
# Choose cytokine matrix
cytok_mat <- cyto_resid_HUU

# Keep shared samples only
shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(cytok_mat), rownames(meta_HUU))

cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta_sub_HUU <- meta_HUU[shared_ids, ]

# -----------------------------
# Remove non-numeric columns
# -----------------------------
cytok_mat <- cytok_mat %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

# -----------------------------
# Remove near-zero variance variables
# -----------------------------
vars <- apply(cytok_mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[, vars > 0, drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------------
# Scale data
# -----------------------------
X <- scale(cytok_mat)

# =========================================================
# PCA
# =========================================================

pca_res <- prcomp(
  X,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# Scree plot
fviz_eig(
  pca_res,
  addlabels = TRUE,
  ylim = c(0, 60)
) +
  ggtitle("HUU Cytokines: Scree Plot")

# Variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)

variance_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(var_explained)),
  Variance = var_explained,
  Cumulative = cumsum(var_explained)
)

print(variance_df)

# =========================================================
# Choose PCs for clustering
# =========================================================

n_pcs <- which(cumsum(var_explained) >= 0.80)[1]

cat("Using", n_pcs, "PCs for Mclust\n")

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$x[, 1:n_pcs]
)

# =========================================================
# Mclust
# =========================================================

mc <- Mclust(pca_scores)

summary(mc)

# Cluster assignments
clusters <- factor(mc$classification)

# Add to metadata
meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster <- clusters

table(meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================

pca_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(pca_res$x),

# -----------------------------

scores$Cluster <- pca_df$Mclust_cluster

# PCA loadings (variables)

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation)

# scale arrows for visualization (important)
arrow_scale <- 3

loadings$Cytokine <- rownames(loadings)

# variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)
pc1_var <- round(100 * var_explained[1], 1)
pc2_var <- round(100 * var_explained[2], 1)

      yend = PC2 * arrow_scale
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = PC1 * arrow_scale,
      y = PC2 * arrow_scale,
      label = Cytokine
    ),

  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cluster_colors,
    labels = c(
      "1" = "P1",
      "2" = "P2"
    ),
    name = "HUU Phenotype"
  ) +
  labs(
    #title = "PCA Biplot of Plasma Cytokines Clusters in HUU",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "% variance)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
``` 

# box plot HUU plasma

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Prepare dataframe
# =========================================================

plot_df <- cytok_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = clusters,
    Sample = rownames(cytok_mat)
  )


# =========================================================
# Convert to long format
# =========================================================

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Cluster, Sample),
    names_to = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Value"
  )


# =========================================================
# Create phenotype labels
# 1 = P1, 2 = P2
# =========================================================

plot_long$Phenotype <- factor(
  plot_long$Cluster,
  levels = c("1", "2"),
  labels = c("P1", "P2")
)

table(plot_long$Phenotype)


# =========================================================
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)
# =========================================================

pairwise_df <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Value ~ Phenotype,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Phenotype")


# =========================================================
# Phenotype colors
# =========================================================

phenotype_colors <- c(
  "P1" = "#D73027",
  "P2" = "#2C7BB6"
)


# =========================================================
# Plot each cytokine
# =========================================================

cytokine_order <- unique(plot_long$Cytokine)

p_list <- lapply(cytokine_order, function(cyt) {

  subdf <- plot_long %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)

  pair_sub <- pairwise_df %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)

  ggplot(
    subdf,
    aes(
      x = Phenotype,
      y = Value,
      fill = Phenotype
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.85,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Phenotype),
      width = 0.12,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +

    stat_pvalue_manual(
      pair_sub,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 4
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = phenotype_colors
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = phenotype_colors
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

    labs(
      title = gsub("Plasma_", "", cyt),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 12,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
})


# =========================================================
# Combine plots
# =========================================================

final_plot_plasma_HUU <- wrap_plots(
  p_list,
  ncol = 3
) +
  plot_annotation(
    # title = "Plasma Cytokine Levels Across Phenotypes in HUU"
  ) &
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )

final_plot_plasma_HUU

library(cowplot)

box_plasma_HUU <- ggdraw(final_plot_plasma_HUU) +
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Create phyloseq object with HUU cluster assignments
# =========================================================

if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_HUU)) {
  physeq_HUU <- t(physeq_HUU)
}

physeq_HUU

physeq_HUU_clust <- physeq_HUU

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster)
meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL)
meta_sub_HUU$host_sex <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$host_sex)
rownames(meta_sub_HUU) <- meta_sub_HUU$host_subject_id

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure sample order matches
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_data(physeq_HUU_clust) <- sample_data(meta_sub_HUU)

physeq_HUU_clust

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extract OTU table (counts)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- as(otu_table(physeq_HUU_clust), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(physeq_HUU_clust)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

otu <- as.data.frame(otu)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HUU_clust))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Bray-Curtis distance
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- otu / rowSums(otu)

bray <- vegdist(
  otu,
  method = "bray"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PCoA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pcoa <- cmdscale(
  bray,
  eig = TRUE,
  k = 2
)

var_exp <- pcoa$eig / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0])

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcoa$points[, 1],
  PC2 = pcoa$points[, 2],
  meta
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Overall PERMANOVA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)

perm_cluster <- adonis2(
  bray ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c,
  data = meta,
  by = "margin"
)

perm_cluster
```

#ANCOMBC HUU plasma


```{r}
# =========================================================
# Prepare phyloseq object for ANCOM-BC2 (HUU)
# =========================================================

# Make sure taxa are rows
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_HUU)) {
  physeq_HUU <- t(physeq_HUU)
}

physeq_HUU_ancom <- physeq_HUU

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster)
meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL)
meta_sub_HUU$host_sex <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$host_sex)

table(meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure sample order matches
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_data(physeq_HUU_ancom) <- sample_data(meta_sub_HUU)

physeq_HUU_ancom



# =========================================================
# Run ANCOM-BC2
# =========================================================

library(ANCOMBC)
set.seed(123)

ancom_res_HUU <- ancombc2(
  data = physeq_HUU_ancom,

  # Fixed effects
  fix_formula = "Mclust_cluster + caries_IL + host_age + host_sex + logCD4_c",

  # No random effects
  rand_formula = NULL,

  tax_level = "Species",
  # prv_cut = 0.10,
  # lib_cut = 1000,
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,
  s0_perc = 0.05,

  group = "Mclust_cluster",
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,

  iter_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100,
    verbose = TRUE
  ),

  em_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100
  ),

  lme_control = lme4::lmerControl(),

  mdfdr_control = list(
    fwer_ctrl_method = "BH",
    B = 1
  ),

  global = TRUE,
  pairwise = TRUE,
  # dunnet = TRUE,
  trend = FALSE,

  verbose = TRUE,
  n_cl = 2
)
```

# Salivary and plasma concordance heatmap


```{r}

# =========================================================
# Contingency table
# =========================================================

cont_df <- meta_HUU_saliva_mclust %>%
  select(
    host_subject_id,
    Saliva = Mclust_cluster
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    meta_HUU_plasma_mclust %>%
      select(
        host_subject_id,
        Plasma = Mclust_cluster
      ),
    by = "host_subject_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(Saliva, Plasma) %>%
  group_by(Saliva) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# =========================================================
# Heatmap
# Saliva = S1, S2, S3
# Plasma = P1, P2
# =========================================================

sal_vs_plas_concord <- ggplot(
  cont_df,
  aes(
    x = factor(Plasma),
    y = factor(Saliva),
    fill = percent
  )
) +

  geom_tile(
    color = "white"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        n,
        "\n(",
        round(percent, 1),
        "%)"
      )
    ),
    size = 5
  ) +

  # Plasma: 1 = P1, 2 = P2
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "1" = "P1",
      "2" = "P2"
    )
  ) +

  # Saliva: 1 = S1, 2 = S2, 3 = S3
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "1" = "S1",
      "2" = "S2",
      "3" = "S3"
    )
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#B2182B"
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  labs(
    # title = "Saliva vs Plasma Immune Phenotype Concordance in HUU",
    x = "HUU Plasma immune phenotype",
    y = "HUU Saliva immune phenotype",
    fill = "% within saliva phenotype"
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "black"
    ),

      size = 16,
      face = "bold"

      size = 16,
      face = "bold"

    ),

  )


sal_vs_plas_concord

```


## Concordance measure , Adjusted Rand Index (ARI)

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Match subjects with saliva and plasma clusters
# =========================================================

cluster_compare <- meta_HUU_saliva_mclust %>%
  select(
    host_subject_id,
    Saliva_cluster = Mclust_cluster
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    meta_HUU_plasma_mclust %>%
      select(
        host_subject_id,
        Plasma_cluster = Mclust_cluster
      ),
    by = "host_subject_id"
  )


# =========================================================
# Contingency table
# =========================================================

cluster_table <- table(
  cluster_compare$Saliva_cluster,
  cluster_compare$Plasma_cluster
)

cluster_table


# =========================================================
# Adjusted Rand Index (primary concordance measure)
# =========================================================

library(mclust)

ARI_HUU <- adjustedRandIndex(
  cluster_compare$Saliva_cluster,
  cluster_compare$Plasma_cluster
)

ARI_HUU

```
